## Load packages
```{r loading packages}
packages <- c("here", "dplyr", "glue", "DT", "janitor", "ggplot2")
for (p in packages) {
  if (p %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  } else {
    install.packages(p)
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

windowsFonts(`Times New Roman` = windowsFont("TT Times New Roman"))
```

## Define data loading and cleaning function
```{r creating function}
#Loops through years, pulling DART hatchery release data for each and
#combining into one dataframe. Filters to the requested region/run_code
hatch_rel_pull_clean <- function(years,
                                 species_code = "ch1",
                                 region_sel = "Upper Columbia",
                                 run_code = "SP"){
  dart_years_list <- list()
  
  for (y in years) {
    cat(glue("loading DART hatchery release data for {y}\n"))
    url <- glue('https://cbr.washington.edu/dart/cs/php/rpt/hatch_rel.php?',
                'sc=1&outputFormat=csv&year={y}&ftype={species_code}')
    year_data <- read.csv(url)
    
    #Some years read Mgr.Year as text; forcing to character keeps
    #all years consistent before combining
    year_data$Mgr.Year <- as.character(year_data$Mgr.Year)
    
    dart_years_list[[as.character(y)]] <- year_data
  }
  
  dart_raw_data_all_years <- bind_rows(dart_years_list)
  
  #Citation/footer rows were mixed into the raw data; filtered out here
  dart_clean_all_years <- dart_raw_data_all_years %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(mgr_year = as.numeric(mgr_year)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mgr_year))
  
  #region_sel accepts a vector, since DART splits some basins (like
  #Snake River) across multiple region labels
  dart_select_region_all_years <- dart_clean_all_years %>%
    filter(region %in% region_sel, run == run_code)
  return(dart_select_region_all_years)
}
```

## Call function for each subset of interest
```{r call function all subsets}
upper_col_sp_chin <- hatch_rel_pull_clean(1979:2025)

#Snake River spans three DART region labels; called twice for spring
#and summer run codes, then combined
snake_sp_chin <- hatch_rel_pull_clean(1979:2025, region_sel = c("Lower Snake", "Salmon", "Clearwater"), run_code = "SP")
snake_su_chin <- hatch_rel_pull_clean(1979:2025, region_sel = c("Lower Snake", "Salmon", "Clearwater"), run_code = "SU")
snake_sp_su_chin <- bind_rows(snake_sp_chin, snake_su_chin)

#species_code = "st" per DART's hatchery release glossary
upper_col_steelhead <- hatch_rel_pull_clean(1979:2025, species_code = "st",
                                             region_sel = "Upper Columbia", run_code = "SU")

snake_steelhead <- hatch_rel_pull_clean(1979:2025, species_code = "st",
                                         region_sel = c("Lower Snake", "Salmon", "Clearwater"), run_code = "SU")

nrow(upper_col_sp_chin)
nrow(snake_sp_su_chin)
nrow(upper_col_steelhead)
nrow(snake_steelhead)
```

```{r combine subsets}
dart_all_subsets <- bind_rows(upper_col_sp_chin, snake_sp_su_chin,
                               upper_col_steelhead, snake_steelhead)

#DART's species column uses "Chinook-1"; recoded to match "Chinook"
dart_all_subsets <- dart_all_subsets %>%
  mutate(
    species_full = case_when(
      species == "Chinook-1" ~ "Chinook",
      TRUE ~ species
    )
  )

dart_all_subsets %>% count(species, species_full)
```

```{r save cleaned data}
write.csv(upper_col_sp_chin,
          here("Results", "CSV Files", "dart_hatch_rel_upper_columbia_spring_all_years.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r load huc population table}
#Filters out placeholder rows where population is the literal string
#"NULL", since those aren't real populations
huc_population_raw <- read.csv(here("Datasets", "HUC_nmfs_population_tables.csv")) %>%
  filter(population != "NULL")
```

```{r clean huc population table}
huc_population_all <- huc_population_raw %>%
  select(hydrologic_huc_8, species, nwfsc_pop_id, population) %>%
  unique()

write.csv(huc_population_all, here("Results", "CSV Files", "huc_population_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r scope population table to release hucs}
#Scopes the population table down to only huc_8 codes that actually
#appear in the release data
release_hucs <- dart_all_subsets %>%
  select(release_huc) %>%
  unique() %>%
  pull(release_huc)

huc_population_uc_snake <- huc_population_all %>%
  filter(hydrologic_huc_8 %in% release_hucs)
```

```{r build unique huc8 dataframe}
huc8_population_count <- huc_population_uc_snake %>%
  select(hydrologic_huc_8, population) %>%
  unique() %>%
  count(hydrologic_huc_8)

#Collapses competing population names per huc_8 into one text field,
#so an ambiguous huc_8's candidates are visible at a glance
huc8_population_list <- huc_population_uc_snake %>%
  select(hydrologic_huc_8, population) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(hydrologic_huc_8) %>%
  summarize(population_list = paste(population, collapse = ", "))

huc8_unique <- huc8_population_list %>%
  left_join(huc8_population_count, by = "hydrologic_huc_8") %>%
  mutate(
    ambiguous = case_when(
      n > 1 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

nrow(huc8_unique)
sum(huc8_unique$ambiguous)
```

```{r join release site to population}
dart_uc_snake_only <- dart_all_subsets %>%
  filter(region %in% c("Upper Columbia", "Lower Snake", "Salmon", "Clearwater"))

#Joins on both huc_8 and species, so a Chinook release only matches a
#Chinook population and a Steelhead release only matches Steelhead
huc_ambiguous <- huc_population_uc_snake %>%
  count(hydrologic_huc_8, species) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  mutate(huc_species_key = paste0(hydrologic_huc_8, "_", species)) %>%
  pull(huc_species_key)

dart_all_subsets_pop <- dart_uc_snake_only %>%
  left_join(huc_population_uc_snake,
            by = c("release_huc" = "hydrologic_huc_8", "species_full" = "species")) %>%
  mutate(
    huc_species_key = paste0(release_huc, "_", species_full),
    population_ambiguous = case_when(
      huc_species_key %in% huc_ambiguous ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

nrow(dart_all_subsets_pop)
nrow(dart_uc_snake_only)

sum(is.na(dart_all_subsets_pop$population))

sum(dart_all_subsets_pop$population_ambiguous)

write.csv(dart_all_subsets_pop,
          here("Results", "CSV Files", "dart_hatch_rel_all_subsets_with_population.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r add basin label}
#Basin label used to filter to one of the four core basin/species
#subsets consistently, matching the basin/species labeling pattern
#used in the other four pipelines
dart_all_subsets_pop <- dart_all_subsets_pop %>%
  mutate(
    basin = case_when(
      region == "Upper Columbia" ~ "Upper Columbia",
      region %in% c("Lower Snake", "Salmon", "Clearwater") ~ "Snake River",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

dart_all_subsets_pop %>% count(basin, species_full)
```

```{r release site population lookup with candidates}
#Reference table of each release site, its population match, the
#ambiguous flag, and competing population candidates for review
release_site_population <- dart_all_subsets_pop %>%
  select(release_site, release_huc, species_full, nwfsc_pop_id, population, population_ambiguous) %>%
  unique() %>%
  left_join(huc8_unique %>% select(hydrologic_huc_8, population_list),
            by = c("release_huc" = "hydrologic_huc_8"))

datatable(release_site_population)
```

```{r sum hatchery releases by population}
#Sums release numbers within each population/HUC8, by year and
#species. Excludes ambiguous or unmatched HUC8s
hatchery_release_by_population_year <- dart_all_subsets_pop %>%
  filter(!is.na(population), population_ambiguous == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(population, species_full, mgr_year) %>%
  summarize(total_hatchery_released = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

datatable(hatchery_release_by_population_year)

excluded_records <- dart_all_subsets_pop %>%
```

```{r define presentation theme and export function}
presentation_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 22),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20)
)

ggsave_presentation <- function(filename, height = 7.5, width = 13.33, dpi = 300){
  ggsave(here("Results", "Figures", filename), height = height, width = width, dpi = dpi)
}

#Releases by individual release site, for one basin/species subset
plot_releases_by_site_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name){
  data %>%
    filter(basin == basin_sel, species_full == species_sel) %>%
    group_by(mgr_year, release_site) %>%
    summarize(n_fish = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mgr_year, y = n_fish, color = release_site)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~ release_site) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = "Number of Fish Released") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}

#Releases by hatchery, for one basin/species subset
plot_releases_by_hatchery_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name){
  data %>%
    filter(basin == basin_sel, species_full == species_sel) %>%
    group_by(mgr_year, hatchery) %>%
    summarize(n_fish = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mgr_year, y = n_fish, fill = hatchery)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~ hatchery) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = "Number Released") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}

#Releases by major release site, for one basin/species subset. "Major"
#means total_released across all years exceeds threshold - default
#1,000,000 carried over from the original Upper Columbia Chinook
#version. This threshold is UNVERIFIED for the other three subsets;
#compare against your existing exported PNGs and adjust if a subset
#comes back with too few (or zero) major sites
plot_releases_by_major_site_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name, threshold = 1000000){
  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(basin == basin_sel, species_full == species_sel)
  
  site_totals <- subset_data %>%
    group_by(release_site) %>%
    summarize(total_released = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  major_sites <- site_totals %>%
    filter(total_released > threshold) %>%
    pull(release_site)
  
  subset_data %>%
    filter(release_site %in% major_sites) %>%
    group_by(mgr_year, release_site) %>%
    summarize(n_fish = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mgr_year, y = n_fish, color = release_site)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~ release_site) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = "Number of Fish Released") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}

#Same "major" logic as above, grouped by hatchery instead of release site
plot_releases_by_major_hatchery_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name, threshold = 1000000){
  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(basin == basin_sel, species_full == species_sel)
  
  hatch_totals <- subset_data %>%
    group_by(hatchery) %>%
    summarize(total_released = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  major_hatcheries <- hatch_totals %>%
    filter(total_released > threshold) %>%
    pull(hatchery)
  
  subset_data %>%
    filter(hatchery %in% major_hatcheries) %>%
    group_by(mgr_year, hatchery) %>%
    summarize(n_fish = sum(number_released, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mgr_year, y = n_fish, color = hatchery)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~ hatchery) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = "Number of Fish Released") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}
```

```{r hatchery release data coverage timeline, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}
#Data coverage: blue = number_released present, dark red = row exists
#but number_released is NA, light red = no row at all
hatchery_data <- dart_all_subsets_pop %>%
  filter(!is.na(mgr_year)) %>%
  select(hatchery, mgr_year, number_released)

hatchery_year_range <- seq(min(hatchery_data$mgr_year), max(hatchery_data$mgr_year))
hatcheries <- unique(hatchery_data$hatchery)

hatchery_full_grid <- data.frame()
for (h in hatcheries) {
  hatchery_full_grid <- bind_rows(hatchery_full_grid, data.frame(hatchery = h, mgr_year = hatchery_year_range))
}

hatchery_data_summary <- hatchery_data %>%
  group_by(hatchery, mgr_year) %>%
  summarize(has_row = TRUE, has_value = any(!is.na(number_released)), .groups = "drop")

hatchery_status <- hatchery_full_grid %>%
  left_join(hatchery_data_summary, by = c("hatchery", "mgr_year")) %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(has_row) ~ "No data reported",
      has_value ~ "Data available",
      TRUE ~ "NA"
    )
  )

hatchery_status %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mgr_year, y = hatchery, fill = status)) +
  geom_tile(height = 0.9, width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Data available" = "blue",
    "NA" = "darkred",
    "No data reported" = "lightcoral"
  )) +
  labs(title = "DART Hatchery Release Data Availability\nby Hatchery (All Subsets)", x = "Year", y = NULL, fill = "Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  presentation_theme

ggsave_presentation("dart_hatch_rel_coverage_by_hat.png")
```
